rule.flow: arrivals = trips ending at the region's stations with ended_at in the window; departures = trips starting there with started_at in the window (same 15-min binning as stations.json tide; trips within a region count on both sides)
rule.window: 60-minute windows sliding in 15-minute steps (a 15-min bin is too noisy for a neighbourhood headline; an hour is the honest unit of a rush)
rule.threshold: window counted only if min(arrivals, departures) >= 100 and arrivals + departures >= 400
rule.ratio: max(arrivals, departures) / min(...), rounded to one decimal in the sentence
rule.pick: highest ratio among candidates with arrivals + departures >= 1000 in the hour (a headline should be about a place where many bikes move; smaller neighbourhoods with higher ratios are listed as runner-ups)
rule.regions: stations assigned to NYC 2020 Neighborhood Tabulation Areas (NYC Open Data 9nt8-h7nd) by point-in-polygon; NTAs grouped into familiar names per REGION_GROUPS in c_encode.py, others keep their NTA name

tide_note: 931 arrivals after midnight are outside the 96 bins and not counted
